acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for professional WordPress sites. A crawl of 5,779 BigScoots sites found a 153 ms median time to first byte, fourth of 13 managed hosts.
Essential 75 is $35 a month, or $350 a year. Core 1000 is $350 a month.

mainEntity.name: Does BigScoots have a Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. BigScoots says on its own blog that it runs no Black Friday or Cyber Monday sales.

mainEntity.name: Does BigScoots offer a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: HostProdigy lists a 45-day money-back guarantee. Confirm on the live page.

mainEntity.name: Does BigScoots migrate sites for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It lists free, zero-downtime migrations by its own team.

mainEntity.name: What is the BigScoots uptime guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: 99.99% on marketing pages and 99.9% in the formal agreement, according to CompareBestAI.
82% of WordPress sites on BigScoots pass Core Web Vitals, against a typical 59%, according to TheWeb.Report.
Yes. It lists 24/7/365 human support with an average reply of about 90 seconds, which is its own claim.

mainEntity.name: Does BigScoots include backups and staging?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Daily backups are kept for 30 days, and staging is included.

mainEntity.name: Does BigScoots have data centers outside the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. HostProdigy lists Chicago and Ashburn, Virginia.
We found none on the pages we read.
